{{Hatnote|This article is about the recurring [[Item]]s. For other uses, see [[Material (Disambiguation)]].}} {{Infobox Item |type= |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Material Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Material Icon.png }} |caption= |game= TFH, BotW, TotK |other= HW, HWL, AoC, AoI |cost= |uses= |comp= {{List| * [[Spoil]]s * [[Treasure]] * [[Ingredient]] }} |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Material|Materials|Series, TFH, BotW, HW, HWL, HWDE|plural}} are a recurring type of [[Item]] in {{TLoZ Series}} used in creating new items.{{Cite|Materials|Tutorial|HWDE}}{{Cite|Materials|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|Materials|Inventory|TotK}}{{Name Ref|TFH}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{TFH|-}}=== {{Main|Magical Material}} [[Magical Material]]s are used to craft various [[Outfit]]s at [[Madame Couture's]]. ====List of Magical Materials==== {{Gallery List|Items |TFH= Antique Coin, Fabled Butterfly, Friendly Token, Gold Dust, Mystery Jade, Royal Ring }} :[[File:TFH Hytopian Silk Icon.png|x26px|link=Magical Material]] [[Magical Material|See more Magical Materials in ''Tri Force Heroes'']] ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Main|Materials in Breath of the Wild}} Materials in {{BotW}} can be found all throughout [[Hyrule]], after defeating [[Enemy|Enemies]], in [[Treasure Chest]]s, or hunting for food. They cover a wide variety of [[Item]]s, and as such have a wide variety of uses. Materials can sometimes be eaten raw, but are best [[Cooking|Cooked]] together to create much more nourishing [[Food#Breath of the Wild|Food]] that restore more [[Heart]]s and have other positive effects. Each type of Material occupies its own slot. There is a maximum capacity of 999 Materials per slot.{{Cite Web|url= https://youtu.be/sGUSY0IoSHs?t=268|title= BotW Glitches & Tricks: Hold Smuggling, and Dead Link Inventory.|author= Kleric|site= YouTube}} Materials are also used to have the [[Great Fairy#Breath of the Wild|Great Fairies]] upgrade [[Armor]]. Materials can be sold for [[Rupee]]s as well. The listed value is the price a merchant will pay Link for the Item. Buying these items from most merchants will cost Link four times this value; [[Beedle]] will charge five times this value. Select materials may also be exchanged for [[Mon]] by [[Kilton]]. ====List of Materials==== {{Gallery List|Items |BotW= Ancient Core, Diamond, Giant Ancient Core, Naydra's Scale, Silent Princess, Star Fragment }} :[[File:BotW Material Icon.png|x26px|link=Materials in Breath of the Wild]] [[Materials in Breath of the Wild|See more Materials in ''Breath of the Wild'']] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Main|Materials in Tears of the Kingdom}} Materials are used in a variety of ways. They are commonly dropped by [[Enemy|Enemies]] but may also be found along the ground. A majority of Materials can be thrown by [[Link]], with the exception of [[Creature]]s. ====List of Materials==== {{Gallery List|Items |TotK= Ancient Blade, King's Scale, Large Zonai Charge, Large Zonaite, Light Dragon's Horn, Muddle Bud }} :[[File:ZW TotK Material.png|x26px|link=Materials in Tears of the Kingdom]] [[Materials in Tears of the Kingdom|See more Materials in ''Tears of the Kingdom'']] ==Other Appearances== ==={{HW|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{HW}}, Materials are similar to [[Spoil]]s and [[Treasure]]s in that each Material is a unique [[Item]] possessed by the [[Enemy]] that dropped it. Materials are dropped by nearly every Enemy type except [[Cucco]]s and infantry soldiers, and only when the Enemy does not drop a [[Dropped Weapon]]. They come in three rarities, with at most two rarities of item for each enemy type. The most common are [[Bronze Material]]s, which are the only item drops for the basic infantry [[Captain (Hyrule Warriors)|Captains]]. [[Silver Material]]s are dropped by unique Captains, [[Warrior]]s, and [[Giant Boss]]es. Rare [[Gold Material]]s are dropped only by Warriors and Giant Bosses. Enemies can be influenced to drop their rarer Materials by using [[Weapon]]s with the "Material+" [[Skill]], by creating a special [[Mixture]] in the [[Apothecary]], or by activating the reward while using [[Focus Spirit]]. Materials are primarily used to craft [[Badge]]s for the playable Warriors, with each Badge having its own recipe of specific Materials. Materials can also be used to brew one-use Mixtures by consuming a set amount of any Material of a given rarity. ====List of Materials==== {{Data Table |game= HWDE |collapse= true |columns= Enemy [Image:Mini Map Icon][Link][Rowspan], Bronze Material [Image][Link], Silver Material [Image][Link], Gold Material [Image][Term] |- | Bulblin [Captain] | Metal Plate | N/A | N/A |- | Stalchild [Captain] | Monster Tooth | N/A | N/A |- | Bokoblin [Captain] | Old Rag | N/A | N/A |- | Hylian Soldier | Soldier's Uniform | N/A | N/A |- | Goron [File:HWDE Goron Captain Mini Map Icon 2.png] | Rock | N/A | N/A |- | Miniblin [Captain]

Feeling very pleased with himself, he threw some crab in the pot with some spicy peppers, only to find out crab wasn’t used for food recipes—it was for elixirs! This happened to fit perfectly with my own personal description of crustaceans as being “the insects of the sea,” but as an east coaster who grew up on crab, Nate wasn’t having it. He contacted Fujibayashi-san that night and began passionately explaining to the development team how much people like to eat crab, begging him to add crab dishes to the menu.|author= Bill Trinen|published= May 3, 2017|retrieved= May 3, 2017|url= https://nintendotreehouse.tumblr.com/post/160273426037/now-youre-cooking-with-power|title= Now You’re Cooking with Power|site= Tumblr|type=}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Hearty Salmon Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of a Hearty Salmon File:BotW Ironshell Crab Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of an Ironshell Crab File:BotW Steaks Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of Meat File:BotW Trout Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of Sizzlefin, Chillfin and Voltfin Trout {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Color AoC|Blue|Material}}|Game Screen|AoC}} {{Cite|{{Color AoI|Green|Materials}}|Game Screen|AoI}} }} {{Categories |items= BotW, HW, HWL, HWDE, AoC, AoI }}
